directorates.name: Communities
directorates._note: Transport, Highways, Environment, Fire and Rescue.

cross_cutting._note: GBP 27.579m of budget reductions in 2026/27 (VERIFIED per-directorate splits from the Revenue Budget Resolution); engine risk-adjusts to ~GBP 17.20m EV. ~10.6m still to scope. Rises to GBP 99.9m by 2030/31.

mtfs_period: 2026/27 balanced via GBP 5.5m MTFS reserve draw (GBP 15.7m over four years); GBP 99.9m savings needed by 2030/31

reserves._note: Total useable revenue reserves GBP 208.361m; minimum general reserve GBP 35.0m (5%); MTFS reserve GBP 17.414m. Caveat: stated reserves are materially overstated because the DSG/SEND deficit is held off-balance-sheet under the override.

risks.risk: DSG / SEND cumulative deficit forecast GBP 157m by March 2026, rising to GBP 327m by 31 March 2028 when the statutory override ends. The High Needs Stability Grant funds 90% of the deficit to end 2025/26 and SEND costs are to be fully Government-funded from 2028/29, but ~GBP 16m/year of financing-cost risk remains if the historic deficit is not written off. No Safety Valve agreement.

Politically fragile minority administration (Reform 20 of 58): the budget passed by 6 votes only after a Conservative + Reform deal on 4.44%; Reform's own 3.89% failed. ~GBP 10.6m of the GBP 27.579m savings still needs further scoping.
Adult social care pressure GBP 23.1m and a Q3 structural directorate overspend GBP 16.126m; Social Care and Health carries GBP 14.591m of the GBP 27.579m savings, the bulk.
